title: MouthBatch
description:
Consecutive samples, sent ahead of the audio they describe. The sender's
clock is monotonic with an arbitrary start: `sent_ms` is its reading when
the batch left, so a receiver learns the offset to its own clock.

MouthSample.description: The mouth at one instant of reply audio.

at_ms.description: When the audio is heard, in milliseconds on the sender's clock.

open.description: How far the mouth is open: 0 is closed, 100 fully open.

MouthVowel.description: The vowel a mouth shapes, or `none` when no vowel is clear.
